source: actual shared DetectionTaskManager with deferred HTTP/XHR events
cases: two upload slots, real XHR progress and immutable input snapshot survive view unsubscribe/navigation and a third queued file
lost create response recovers the same client UUID through GET without another POST
lost accepted upload response checks the original server task without reuploading or recreating
duplicate cancel calls share one request and cancelling remains pending until the server confirms cancelled
a completed server commit wins cancellation and its stored result IDs are retained
server task disappearance becomes explicit failure without a duplicate reservation
changed account stops callbacks, aborts files and cancels only captured old-service tasks with the captured old token
empty browser File.type uses the same nonempty MIME fallback in reservation and raw upload
explicit upload 429 retains the original file and retries only PUT on the same reserved task after bounded backoff
late GET 404 cannot downgrade an already confirmed completed upload or discard its stored result IDs
GET-confirmed completion survives a late XHR error and unavailable status lookup without reentering checking
late reservation after disposal is cancelled with the old session token and cannot publish into a new account
